senses.gloss: to be on top, float on the surface. Part. pass. קָפוּי; f. קְפוּיָה; pl. קְפוּיִים, קְפוּיִין; קְפוּיוֹת light of weight.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 50a:4">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>יקרות וקפאון</he>, <cite ref="Zechariah 14:6">Zech. XIV, 6</cite>) <he>אור שיקר בעוה״ז ק׳ הוא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>וק׳</he>) light which is weighty (precious, rare) in this world shall be light (little esteemed, an ordinary thing) in the world to come; <cite ref="Zechariah 14:6">ib.</cite> <he>נגעים … וקפויין וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קפויות</he>) the treatises Negaim and Oholoth, which are heavy (difficult, obscure) in this world, shall be light (easily understood) &c., <cite ref="Zechariah 14:6">ib.</cite> <he>אלו בני אדם …</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>ק׳ הם וכ׳</he> those who are weighty (important on account of their wealth, though otherwise without merit) in this world, shall be light (disregarded) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 583">Yalk. Zech. 583</cite>.

Gen. R. s. 4 כיון שירד … מיד הוא קוֹפֵא ועומד ed. Wil. (oth. ed. קוֹפֶה) as soon as a drop of m’so (v. מְסוֹ) is put in, the milk curdles and ‘stands’ (v. עָמַד); ib. s. 14 קופה (ed. Wil. קָפוּי); Lev. R. s. 14 נִקְפָּא. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 17">ib.</cite>, Shirah, s. 6 <he>קפא עליהם וכ׳</he> the sea around them was congealed as far as &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 248:3">Yalk. Ex. 248</cite> <cite ref="S01730"><he>נִקְפָּה</he></cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:7">Tosef. Maasr. I, 7</cite>, v. infra.]

senses.gloss: to skim, take off the scum and the substances that gather on wine when it begins to ferment.
units: Maasr. I, 7 היין משיְקַפֶּה אע״פ שקי׳ וכ׳ Y. ed. (Bab. and Mish. ed. שקִפָּה) wine is subject to tithes when the manufacturer begins to skim; but although he has skimmed, he may take &c.; Tosef. ib. I, 7 אע״פ שקופה ed. Zuck. (Var. שקיפה); Ab. Zar. 56ᵃ; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ; [Maim. to Maasr. l. c. seems to read משיִקְפֶּה, expl. to form scum]. Tosef. l. c. שולה וקופה ed. Zuck. (Var. שילה וקיפה), v. שָׁלָה.

Maasr. IV, 1 המְקַפֵּא לתבשיל he that skims for the purpose of taking wine for a dish; Tosef. ib. I, 9 המְקַפֶּה בעריבה he that skims and takes wine out in a trough; a. fr.—In gen. to take from the top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:11">Ter. IV, 11</cite> <he>סאה … וְקִפְּאָהּ</he> if one S’ah of T’rumah fell on top of a pile, and he took it off.

Ib. יְקַפְּאֶנָּה Mish. ed. (Bab. ed. יַקְפִּיאֶנָּה Hif.; Y. ed. Krot. ייקפינה, read: יְקַפֶּינָּה; Ms. M. יקיפנה, corr. acc.) let him take it off. Y. ib. 43ᵃ bot. קפה וחזר וק׳ if he took from the top once and again; a. e.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:5">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>המַקְפֶּה אכילתו במים</he> he that makes his food float in water (who drinks freely after meals).
Sabb. 21ᵃ להַקְפּוֹת to keep the wick floating.—3) to curdle, congeal; to cause coagulation; to become thick.

<cite ref="Chullin 120a:14">Ḥull. 120ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 21a:8">Men. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ את הדם</he> if he made the blood thick (through boiling); <cite ref="Menachot 21a">ib.</cite> <he>הִקְפָּהוּ באור</he> Mss. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) if he made it thick by means of artificial heat; <he>הקפהו בחמה</he> by exposure to the sun.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 10:10">Job X, 10</cite>) <he>הִקְפִיאֲתָנִי אינו אומר וכ׳</he> it does not read, thou hast curdled me, but thou wilt &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:1">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>הִקְפֵּאתַנִי</he> (some ed. <he>הִקְפֵּתַנִי</he>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:14">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 15:8">Ex. XV, 8</cite>) <he>ה׳ שלישו של ים</he> he made one-third of the sea thick (v. supra); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be curdled, made thick. Lev. R. l. c.; Yalk. Ex. 248, v. supra.—[Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ ניקפת, read: נִיכְפֵּית, v. כָּפָה.]
